name: Pace E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, PACE E-Commerce Ventures Ltd is in the business of selling Branded /Customized and personalized products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
PACEECVL is a multi-platform online retailer and print-on-demand manufacturing enterprise. It offers B2C and B2B platforms for personalized and customized products.
Company has ~1,000+ designs, ~100+ Distributors, ~15+ Own and Licensed brands, ~10+ Multi Brand Outlet Chains, ~9+ Major product categories, ~1 Platform in pipeline, ~7 Active platforms, ~1,500+ Sales Points, ~400+ products

pros: Stock is trading at 0.57 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 50.6 to 33.9 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 110 days to 74.4 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -7.53%
Company has a low return on equity of 3.24% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 30.9% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.48 Cr.
